content.text:
Read-only findings from the current checkout.

- `frontend/src/LandingPage.svelte` is a static heading and navigation. `frontend/src/App.svelte` renders `<LandingPage />` without data. The `/` branch of `frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts` returns `{kind:"landing"}` before resolving API origin. Extend that branch, `PageModel` in `frontend/src/lib/page.ts`, and the landing component props.
- Rust exposes only `/search`, `/members/{id}`, `/funders/{id}`, and `/healthz` in `exposed/src/lib/inbound/http/routes.rs`. There is no homepage statistics endpoint or all-member totals repository operation.
- Authoritative aggregation is in `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs`. `summarize_member` builds historical, current term, and current year summaries through `PeriodAggregate`. Its private `CurrentParliamentStart` owns the inclusive `2024-07-09T00:00:00Z` boundary. Extract/reuse these rules when building aggregate charts. Do not independently reconstruct totals in SQL or the frontend.
- `EntityDetailsRepo` currently reads one `MemberHistory` at a time. Its implementation in `exposed/src/lib/outbound/entity_details.rs` reads declarations and funding entries inside a repeatable-read transaction with SQLx macros. A bulk read can preserve this shape while avoiding hundreds of individual profile requests.
- `MemberProfile` in `domain/models/entity_details.rs` contains `is_current_commons`, `party_id`, and `party_name`. Party metadata means latest stored affiliation, explicitly not affiliation when a declaration occurred. Current-term registration filtering and selection of current Commons members are separate concepts. The chosen population must be explicit.
- The reusable charts already exist. `ui/BarChart.svelte` consumes numeric geometry and formatted title strings. `ui/PieChart.svelte` consumes `PieSlice[]` with share, SVG path, color, label, formatted value, and detail. `SignedBarList` could render a five-member ranking. Features own monetary formatting, geometry, URLs, and availability. Read `ui/README.md` and `ui/COMPOSITION.md`.
- `frontend/src/lib/funder-summary.ts` demonstrates exact bigint-based pie ratios and party colors. It merges Labour and Labour (Co-op), clamps nonpositive values to zero for slices, and converts only a bounded calculated ratio to Number. These are existing funder presentation decisions, not an automatic homepage contract.
- `frontend/src/lib/server/entity-details.ts` demonstrates strict API parsing of decimal strings, null amounts, declaration counts, and incomplete flags. Preserve strings across SSR. `sum-amounts.ts` can add decimals exactly, but homepage totals belong in the backend rather than fallback frontend sums.
- Null is not zero. Known foreign currencies are excluded without incompleteness. Unknown currencies and missing GBP amounts mark totals incomplete. All categories, including unknown category IDs, count. Undated records belong only to historical totals. Labels must say declared amounts. A partial known amount must retain its incomplete flag through ranking and party aggregation.
- Quartiles need an explicit statistical rule and population. Unknown amounts cannot silently become zero. Negative amounts need deliberate distribution and pie behavior. Backend exact decimal quartile thresholds and ranking are the safest extension.
- Regression evidence exists in `domain/services/entity_details.rs` unit tests and `outbound/entity_details/tests.rs::declared_totals_include_all_categories_and_preserve_coverage`. Frontend tests include `member-summary.spec.ts`, `loader-adapters.spec.ts`, and detailed financial cases in `entity-details.spec.ts`.
- `landing.spec.ts` currently asserts no backend requests and exact viewport-height fit at desktop and mobile sizes. Both assumptions require revision. `tests/backend.ts` launches a real built Svelte application against a mock HTTP backend; existing homepage navigation tests need a default statistics fixture or an intentional graceful unavailable state.
- `playwright.config.ts` recognizes unit tests only through the `member-summary|funder-summary|loader-adapters` filename regex. Add any new pure adapter test file there.
- Verification requires Node 24+, `npm ci`, `npm run check`, `npm run build`, and affected Playwright tests. Gallery tests use development mode. Other browser tests use the built Node application through fixtures. Rust targets version 1.94; SQLx integration tests use isolated migrated databases.
- UI PRs require desktop screenshots uploaded as GitHub attachments. Changes must occur in a `wt switch --create … --base main` worktree and be committed after validation. No files were changed.
